title: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
title_original: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 9 (Protection of Information, etc.)
(1) When establishing and operating the electronic personnel management system, the Minister of the Interior and Safety, the heads of local governments, and the chairpersons of local councils shall take necessary measures to prevent any person other than a person with lawful authority under relevant statutes and regulations from accessing personal information, confidential personnel matters, or other matters requiring equivalent protection. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017; November 30, 2021>
(2) The Minister of the Interior and Safety, the heads of local governments, and the chairpersons of local councils establishing and operating the electronic personnel management system shall take necessary measures to prevent forgery, alteration, damage, loss, or electronic intrusion involving electronic documents and databases managed under the system. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017; November 30, 2021>
